sentences.text: 2. By means of the present petition, the petitioners herein seek directions in the nature of mandamus commanding the land acquisition authority to decide the application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short "the Act, 1894") pending since 15.02.2023.

3. Initially, when the matter was taken up, on the intimation given by the learned Assistant Government Pleader NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/2149/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 30/03/2026 undefined appearing for the State-respondents that a First Appeal has been filed against the reference Court award dated 07.01.2023, which is the basis of filing of the application under Section 28A of the Act, 1894, we have postponed the hearing of the present petition.

4. It is brought on record that the First Appeal No. F/21577 of 2025 filed along with the delay condonation application challenging the reference Court award dated 07.01.2023, has now been dismissed vide judgment and order dated 16.01.2026 on the ground of delay.

5. The learned Additional Advocate General appearing for the State-respondents would submit that the State is considering for approaching the Apex Court challenging the order passed by the First Appellate Court.
However, no such petition has been filed till date.

6. It is also pertinent to note that under an order dated 29.05.2025 passed by the Deputy Collector/Special Land Acquisition Officer disposing of the application under Section 28A, the petitioners have been found entitled to the benefits NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/2149/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 30/03/2026 undefined of the reference Court award dated 07.01.2023.

The order passed by the competent authority disposing of the application under Section 28A and the computation of the compensation payable to the petitioners has been brought on record, by means of an affidavit dated 04.07.2025 filed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Narmada Project,
Ahmedabad.
7.

The only apprehension shown by the learned Additional Advocate General for disbursement of compensation to the petitioners is that, in case the State succeeds before the Apex Court and then the First Appeal is entertained on merit, and finally the State succeeds, the State will not be able to realize the compensation amount once paid to the petitioners herein.

8. The submission is that this Court may clarify that the payments made to the petitioners herein under the order under Section 28A be made subject to the outcome of the proposed challenge to the order of the First Appellate Court before the Apex Court.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/2149/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 30/03/2026 undefined 9.

Taking note of the above, we dispose of the present petition with the directions to the respondent-Special Land Acquisition Officer to complete the process of disbursement of the compensation amount determined under the award dated 29.05.2025 under Section 28A of the Act,
1894 to the persons interested/petitioners herein, after due verification of their entitlement, as early as possible, preferably within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.
